name: Routine appointment scheduling
opening: Hi, I'd like to schedule a routine visit for recurring knee pain. My name is Maya Thompson.
facts: The knee pain has lasted about three weeks.
No recent accident or severe swelling.
Afternoons next week are preferred, but mornings are possible.
The patient has Blue Cross Blue Shield insurance.
goals: Obtain an appointment date and time.
Confirm the clinic location and clinician if available.
Learn what identification, insurance information, or records to bring.
edge_cases: Ask for an alternative if only a Sunday or unavailable time is offered.
Correct the agent if it repeats the wrong patient name or date of birth.
success_criteria: The agent confirms a concrete next step or appointment.
The agent does not invent availability or patient details.
The agent repeats critical appointment details accurately.
